meta.description: Automate Airtable tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): records, bases, tables, fields, views. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动操作 Airtable 中的记录、表格和视图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Airtable 中手动更新数据或管理表格
copy.tagline_en: Automate Airtable records, bases, tables, and views
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently update data or manage tables in Airtable manually

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Rube MCP 自动操作 Airtable，包括增删改查记录、管理字段和表格、搜索过滤数据以及查看评论。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 在 Airtable 中创建、更新、删除或查找记录，或者管理表格结构时触发。

say.text: 帮我列出 Airtable 中所有基础。
查找“任务”表中状态为“完成”的所有记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate Airtable operations via Rube MCP, including CRUD on records, managing fields and tables, searching/filtering data, and viewing comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create, update, delete, or find records in Airtable, or manage table structure.

say_en.text: List all bases in my Airtable.
say_en.note: Claude will call AIRTABLE_LIST_BASES to return the list.

say_en.text: Add a record to the 'Customers' table with fields: Name=John, Email=john@example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will get schema first, then call AIRTABLE_CREATE_RECORD.

say_en.text: Find all records in 'Tasks' table where Status is 'Done'.
say_en.note: Claude will use filterByFormula to filter records.
